schoolId: Nullable provider school identifier. Missing IDs are preserved.
approved: Approval at the source snapshot date.
featureType: Provider category for a mapped plan point.
sourceRetrievedAt: UTC retrieval time of the geometry source.
evidence: Geometry source URL; the manifest identifies the checksummed receipt.
schoolApprovalEvidenceUrl: Optional independent evidence of school plan approval.
id: GeoJSON feature ID, UDOT layer plus GlobalID or its layer object ID.
